Minimum test scores in three standardized tests from three different subject matters.

Three transferable 4-credit college laboratory science courses from the following: biology, chemistry, earth science or physics.

MyPath2ASU®
MyPath2ASU® is ASU's transfer admission guarantee, designed to simplify your journey to a bachelor's degree.
MyPath2ASU® creates personalized, course-by-course transfer maps for any regionally accredited community college or four-year institution.
Simply enter your chosen major and transfer school, and MyPath2ASU® will identify the courses at your current institution that directly apply to your ASU major and satisfy ASU transfer requirements.
This personalized map helps you save time and money and minimize credit loss as you prepare to transfer to ASU.
A nondegree student is one who has not attended ASU as a degree-seeking student, has not earned a bachelor's degree, is not attending full time, and is not currently applying to a degree program.
Visiting university students interested in taking classes can find information on how to apply and enroll in classes at https://admission.asu.edu/visiting.
Nondegree students can enroll in eight credit hours for each fall, spring, and summer semester, with a maximum limit of 24 credit hours over the course of the academic year.
Nondegree students may apply up to 15 hours taken in nondegree status to a degree program if they choose to pursue an undergraduate degree in the future.
Nondegree students are not eligible for financial aid.
Nondegree students may not be eligible for academic advising.
VA education benefits are often not applicable to nondegree-seeking students.
Exceptions to the nondegree guidelines may be made for specific programs or partners with approval from the provost’s office.

It may be advisable to speak with your high school counselor prior to enrollment.

programme_facts.value: ASU uses the American Council on Education's Guide to the Evaluation of Educational Experiences in the Armed Services to assess how to transfer military credits to ASU. In general, a military course must be similar to an ASU undergraduate course to transfer to ASU.
